ownership_summary: Owned by the Irsay family since Robert Irsay acquired the Baltimore Colts in 1972. After Jim Irsay's death in May 2025, ownership passed to his daughters Carlie Irsay-Gordon (principal owner and CEO), Casey Foyt and Kalen Jackson; the club calls itself one of the few NFL franchises under sole family ownership. No stake split is stated.
